/-!
# Gale-Shapley deferred acceptance substrate

This file records the formal substrate for a man-proposing deferred acceptance
campaign.  The first pass deliberately keeps the mechanism data ordinary:
preferences are strict decidable relations, a matching is an assignment from
women to optional men, and proposal states carry the current held assignment
plus each man's remaining proposal list.
-/

namespace GaleShapleyStableMatching

universe u v

/-- A strict, decidable, tie-free preference relation for each agent over an
opposite-side alternative type. -/
structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

section Preferences

variable {Agent : Type u} {Alt : Type v}

theorem anchor_StrictPreference_asymm
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) (agent : Agent) {x y : Alt}
    (hxy : prefs.pref agent x y) :
    ¬ prefs.pref agent y x := by
  intro hyx
  exact prefs.irrefl agent x (prefs.trans agent hxy hyx)

theorem anchor_StrictPreference_exactly_one_of_ne
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) (agent : Agent) {x y : Alt}
    (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (prefs.pref agent x y ∧ ¬ prefs.pref agent y x) ∨
      (prefs.pref agent y x ∧ ¬ prefs.pref agent x y) := by
  rcases prefs.total agent hxy with hp | hp
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hp, anchor_StrictPreference_asymm prefs agent hp⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hp, anchor_StrictPreference_asymm prefs agent hp⟩

/-- Weak preference induced by a strict preference: equality or strict
preference. -/
def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

theorem anchor_WeaklyPrefers_characterization
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefs agent x y ↔ x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y :=
  Iff.rfl

end Preferences

section Choice

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- The man a woman prefers from a two-man menu.  It is intentionally a direct
`if` on her strict preference so the two branches reduce. -/
def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

theorem sanity_chooseBetterForW_left
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) {w : Woman} {a b : Man}
    (h : prefW.pref w a b) :
    chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = a := by
  simp [chooseBetterForW, h]

theorem sanity_chooseBetterForW_right
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) {w : Woman} {a b : Man}
    (h : ¬ prefW.pref w a b) :
    chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = b := by
  simp [chooseBetterForW, h]

theorem anchor_chooseBetterForW_returns_arg
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (a b : Man) :
    chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = a ∨ chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = b := by
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w a b
  · exact Or.inl (sanity_chooseBetterForW_left prefW h)
  · exact Or.inr (sanity_chooseBetterForW_right prefW h)

theorem anchor_chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_left
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (a b : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w a b) a := by
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w a b
  · simp [WeaklyPrefers, chooseBetterForW, h]
  · have hba_or : b = a ∨ prefW.pref w b a := by
      by_cases hEq : b = a
      · exact Or.inl hEq
      · rcases prefW.total w hEq with hba | hab
        · exact Or.inr hba
        · exact False.elim (h hab)
    rcases hba_or with hEq | hba
    · simp [WeaklyPrefers, chooseBetterForW, h, hEq]
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa [chooseBetterForW, h] using hba)

theorem anchor_chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_right
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (a b : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w a b) b := by
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w a b
  · exact Or.inr (by simpa [chooseBetterForW, h] using h)
  · simp [WeaklyPrefers, chooseBetterForW, h]

end Choice

section Matching

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- A tentative matching is represented by the man each woman currently holds,
if any. -/
structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/
def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

theorem anchor_NoDuplicateHolds_characterization (μ : Matching Man Woman) :
    NoDuplicateHolds μ ↔
      ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man},
        μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂ :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- The empty matching. -/
def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

theorem sanity_emptyMatching_noDuplicate :
    NoDuplicateHolds (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman) := by
  intro w₁ w₂ m h
  cases h

@[simp] theorem sanity_emptyMatching_held (w : Woman) :
    (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman).held w = none :=
  rfl

/-- A man is free when no woman currently holds him. -/
def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

theorem anchor_freeMan_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) :
    freeMan μ m ↔ ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem sanity_emptyMatching_free [DecidableEq Man] (m : Man) :
    freeMan (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman) m := by
  intro w
  simp [freeMan, emptyMatching]

/-- The woman holding a given man, if one exists.  Under `NoDuplicateHolds` this
is independent of the witness chosen. -/
noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

@[simp] theorem sanity_partnerOfMan_empty (m : Man) :
    partnerOfMan (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman) m = none := by
  unfold partnerOfMan emptyMatching
  simp

theorem anchor_partnerOfMan_some_iff_of_noDuplicate : ∀ [DecidableEq Man] {μ : Matching Man Woman}
    (hμ : NoDuplicateHolds μ) (m : Man) (w : Woman), partnerOfMan μ m = some w ↔ μ.held w = some m := by
  intro _ μ hμ m w
  constructor

open GaleShapleyStableMatching
variable {Agent : Type u} {Alt : Type v}
variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

-- [family-lemma-library] banked: FreeManIn
def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

-- [family-lemma-library] banked: ProposalStepRel
structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

/-- The opening state: nobody is held, and every man has his full proposal list. -/

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

-- [family-lemma-library] banked: ProposalRun
inductive ProposalRun (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) :
    ProposalState Man Woman → List Man → ProposalState Man Woman → Prop
  | nil (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : ProposalRun prefW state [] state
  | cons {state mid final : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man} {schedule : List Man} :
      ProposalStepRel prefW state m mid →
        ProposalRun prefW mid schedule final →
          ProposalRun prefW state (m :: schedule) final

-- APPROACH (advisory blueprint / proof-idea guidance; the kernel verifies every step):
-- # Stable matching — deferred acceptance produces a matching with no blocking pair, across any complete proposal run
--
-- Opens the **market design / two-sided matching** frontier — the mechanism that clears the medical-residency match
-- (NRMP), public-school choice, and kidney exchange, and the one whose "intent" is contested in court and in policy
-- (the NRMP faced antitrust litigation over exactly what the match guarantees). The iconic result is Gale–Shapley:
-- run the deferred-acceptance procedure — each unengaged agent proposes down its preference list, each receiver keeps
-- its best proposer so far and rejects the rest — and the outcome is **stable**: no man and woman both strictly
-- prefer each other to the partner the match assigned them. Stability is the property the field means by "the match
-- is fair to participants," and it is what makes a centralized clearinghouse hold together against side deals. This is
-- the library's first result over an **iterative allocation process whose invariant is a monotone tentative
-- assignment** — the deferred-acceptance reachable-state induction, a discrete counterpart of the CLOB matching
-- engine, over preference orders rather than prices.
--
-- Assumption-accounting note: the results depend on (1) **strict preferences** — each man strictly ranks the women
-- and each woman strictly ranks the men, so "most preferred remaining" and "prefers m to my partner" are
-- unambiguous (no ties); (2) the **deferred-acceptance rule** — a woman holding a man releases him only for a man she
-- strictly prefers, and a man proposes to women in strict decreasing order of his preference and never re-proposes to
-- one who rejected him; (3) a **complete (quiescent) run** — the proposal schedule runs until no unengaged man has any
-- un-proposed woman left. Assumption (3) is the load-bearing admissibility hypothesis, and dropping it is exactly how
-- a blocking pair survives (a man who never got to propose to a woman he prefers). Surface where each is used. Keep
-- the two sides as arbitrary finite carriers and each agent's preference as a decidable strict linear order over the
-- opposite side; do **not** fix a decidable finite instance, and do not restrict to a single proposal step or a
-- two-agent market — the quantification over an arbitrary complete run is the point. A non-closure is an honest gap.
-- Probe the banked DeFi/AMM/CLOB `List.foldl` reachable-state invariant pattern for the deferred-acceptance induction.
--
-- ## Domain
-- formalization-nonmath
--
-- ## Theory file
-- gale_shapley_stable_matching_theory.lean
--
-- ## Property class
-- SAFETY. The Target is an invariant of the terminal reachable state — the quiescent matching admits no blocking
-- pair — proved by induction over the proposal schedule (the DeFi/AMM/CLOB `List.foldl` shape). The **LIVENESS** dual
-- is deliberately **not** proven: that a quiescent state is always reached (deferred acceptance terminates, so a
-- complete stable matching always exists). Existence-via-termination is the frontier the library has not yet closed;
-- this target assumes a run reaches quiescence and characterizes what that terminal state guarantees.
--
-- ## Vocabulary (build these as definitions — do not prove them)
-- - **Man / Woman**: the two finite sides of the market (the proposing side and the receiving side).
-- - **prefM / prefW**: `prefM m x y` means man `m` strictly prefers woman `x` to woman `y`; `prefW w a b` means woman
--   `w` strictly prefers man `a` to man `b`. Each is a **strict linear order over the opposite side** — irreflexive,
--   transitive, and total on distinct agents (any two distinct alternatives are comparable) — and **decidable**, so
--   the choice tests below `REDUCE` rather than sitting behind an opaque `∃`.
-- - **chooseBetterForW**: given a woman `w` and two men, the man `w` prefers — a **plain computable `def`** by a
--   direct `if` on the decidable `prefW` (so `simp [chooseBetterForW]` / `if_pos` reduce it). It returns one of the
--   two men, never a third.
-- - **Matching**: an assignment `held : Woman → Option Man` (the man a woman currently holds, or none) in which no man
--   is held by two women — the deferred-acceptance process maintains this injectivity, since a man proposes only while
--   unheld. **partnerOfMan**: the woman holding a given man, or none (well-defined by that injectivity).
-- - **freeMan**: a man no woman currently holds.
-- - **BlockingPair**: a man `m` and woman `w` such that `m` strictly prefers `w` to `partnerOfMan m` (or `m` is a
--   freeMan) **and** `w` strictly prefers `m` to `held w` (or `w` holds no one) — both would defect from the match to
--   pair with each other. Formalize it as a **decidable** predicate on the two `Option` partners (a `Bool`/`Decidable
--   Prop` that reduces), never an opaque existential.
-- - **Stable**: a matching with **no** blocking pair.
-- - **ProposalState**: the deferred-acceptance state — the current `held : Woman → Option Man` together with, for each
--   man, `rem : Man → List Woman`, the women he has **not yet** proposed to, in his strict preference order.
-- - **openingState**: every woman holds no one (`held w = none`) and every man's `rem` is his full preference-ordered
--   list of women.
-- - **proposalStep**: a **plain computable `def`** advancing one proposal — given a freeMan `m` whose `rem m` is
--   nonempty, `m` proposes to its head `w`; `w` becomes `chooseBetterForW w` applied to her current holder and `m`
--   (keeping the better, rejecting the other); `rem m` drops its head. A step that names an ineligible man is the
--   identity. Define it by a **direct `if`** on the decidable freeMan/`rem` tests so it unfolds definitionally.
-- - **postProposals**: apply a finite proposal **schedule** (a `List Man`, the order in which men are activated to
--   make their next proposal) to a state in order — a left fold of `proposalStep`.
-- - **reachable**: a state equal to `postProposals sched openingState` for some finite schedule `sched`.
-- - **Quiescent**: a state in which **no** freeMan has a nonempty `rem` — every man is either held by a woman or has
--   exhausted his preference list. The completeness hypothesis of the Target.
--
-- ## Anchors (prove these — they PIN each def's meaning; a representation-dependent def cannot prove them)
-- - **chooseBetterForW returns the woman's genuine preference-maximum of the two**: for any woman `w` and men `a`, `b`,
--   `chooseBetterForW w a b` is one of `a`, `b`, and `w` weakly prefers it to both. A positional / first-argument
--   choice cannot prove this — the anchor forces the preference-driven selection, the analog of `bestBid` being the
--   max rather than a list head.
-- - **prefW / prefM are strict linear orders — comparability and no ties**: for distinct men `a`, `b`, exactly one of
--   `prefW w a b` and `prefW w b a` holds (symmetrically for `prefM`). This forces the total, tie-free preference
--   relation the "most preferred remaining" pointer and the blocking test rely on, over a merely partial or
--   positional ranking.
--
-- ## Target
-- Consider man-proposing deferred acceptance over two finite sides with strict preferences: starting from the empty
-- matching, unengaged men propose to women in strict order of preference, and each woman tentatively holds the best
-- proposer she has seen and rejects the rest, a held man being displaced only by one she strictly prefers. After
-- **any** finite proposal schedule that runs to quiescence — no unengaged man has an un-proposed woman left — the
-- resulting matching is **stable**: there is no blocking pair, i.e. no man and woman who each strictly prefer the
-- other to the partner the match assigned them. So the outcome of a complete deferred-acceptance run is immune to
-- pairwise defection. Surface that quiescence is load-bearing: an incomplete run can leave an unengaged man who
-- strictly prefers a woman he never reached, and that pair blocks — so stability is a property of the **completed**
-- run, not of an arbitrary partial one. (The dual guarantee that a quiescent state is always reached — termination
-- and hence existence of a stable matching — is the liveness result this target does not cover.)
--

-- - Along any proposal schedule from the opening state, a woman's held man is monotone under her preference: at any
--   reachable state she weakly prefers her held man to any man she held at an earlier reachable state, and once she
--   holds a man she is never again free.
-- - If a woman rejects a man at some reachable state — she keeps or takes another over him — then at every later
--   reachable state she holds a man she strictly prefers to the one she rejected.
-- - The women a man has already proposed to form an initial segment of his preference order at every reachable state;
--   in particular, at a quiescent state a man has proposed to every woman he strictly prefers to his own assigned
--   partner (and to every woman, if he is unengaged).
-- - At a quiescent reachable state the matching is stable: for every man `m` and woman `w`, they are not a blocking
--   pair — the completed run leaves no pair who would both defect to each other.
-- - Quiescence is load-bearing: there is a profile and a non-quiescent reachable state whose matching has a blocking
--   pair, so the quiescence hypothesis in the stability claim cannot be dropped.
--

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

    updateHeld held w newHeld w = newHeld := by
  simp [updateHeld]

section Stability

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- Man-side strict preference over a concrete optional current partner.  Being
unmatched makes every woman strictly better than the current outcome. -/
def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

instance instDecidableManPrefersOption
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) (partner : Option Woman) :
    Decidable (ManPrefersOption prefM m w partner) := by
  cases partner with
  | none => exact isTrue trivial
  | some w' => exact prefM.decidablePref m w w'

theorem anchor_ManPrefersOption_none
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    ManPrefersOption prefM m w none ↔ True :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem anchor_ManPrefersOption_some
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w w' : Woman) :
    ManPrefersOption prefM m w (some w') ↔ prefM.pref m w w' :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Woman-side strict preference over a concrete optional current holder.  An
unmatched woman strictly prefers any proposer to being unmatched. -/
def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

instance instDecidableWomanPrefersOption
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (m : Man) (partner : Option Man) :
    Decidable (WomanPrefersOption prefW w m partner) := by
  cases partner with
  | none => exact isTrue trivial
  | some m' => exact prefW.decidablePref w m m'

theorem anchor_WomanPrefersOption_none
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (m : Man) :
    WomanPrefersOption prefW w m none ↔ True :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem anchor_WomanPrefersOption_some
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (m m' : Man) :
    WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (some m') ↔ prefW.pref w m m' :=
  Iff.rfl

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

theorem anchor_ManPrefersCurrent_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ↔
      ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- A blocking pair: both sides strictly prefer pairing with each other to their
current options. -/
noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

theorem anchor_BlockingPair_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w ↔
      ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- A stable matching has no blocking pair. -/
noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

theorem anchor_Stable_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) :
    Stable prefM prefW μ ↔ ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w :=
  Iff.rfl

end Stability

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- Deferred-acceptance state: current tentative matching plus each man's
remaining proposal list. -/

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

@[simp] theorem sanity_openingState_held (fullList : Man → List Woman) (w : Woman) :
    (openingState fullList).matching.held w = none :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem sanity_openingState_rem (fullList : Man → List Woman) (m : Man) :
    (openingState fullList).rem m = fullList m :=
  rfl

theorem sanity_openingState_free [DecidableEq Man]
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (m : Man) :
    freeMan (openingState fullList).matching m := by
  exact sanity_emptyMatching_free m

/-- A proposal list is written in decreasing strict preference order. -/
def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

theorem anchor_ProposalListOrdered_pairwise
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (women : List Woman) :
    ProposalListOrdered prefM m women ↔
      women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂) :=
  Iff.rfl

@[simp] theorem sanity_ProposalListOrdered_nil
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) :
    ProposalListOrdered prefM m [] := by
  simp [ProposalListOrdered]

@[simp] theorem sanity_ProposalListOrdered_singleton
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    ProposalListOrdered prefM m [w] := by
  simp [ProposalListOrdered]

/-- Initial proposal lists contain no duplicate women and are ordered by the
man's strict preference. -/
def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

theorem anchor_ProposalListsSound_characterization
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (fullList : Man → List Woman) :
    ProposalListsSound prefM fullList ↔
      ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- One activation in the proposal schedule.  A non-free man, or a free man with
no remaining women, leaves the state unchanged. -/
def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)
        { matching := { held := updateHeld state.matching.held w nextHeld }
          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

theorem sanity_proposalStep_not_free_identity
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    {state : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man}
    (hnot : ¬ freeMan state.matching m) :
    proposalStep prefW state m = state := by
  simp [proposalStep, hnot]

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

/-- The opening state: nobody is held, and every man has his full proposal list. -/

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

inductive ProposalRun (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) :
    ProposalState Man Woman → List Man → ProposalState Man Woman → Prop
  | nil (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : ProposalRun prefW state [] state
  | cons {state mid final : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man} {schedule : List Man} :
      ProposalStepRel prefW state m mid →
        ProposalRun prefW mid schedule final →
          ProposalRun prefW state (m :: schedule) final

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

def QuiescentState (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : Man, FreeManIn state.matching m → state.rem m = []

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrentNoDecidable
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :

noncomputable def BlockingPairNoDecidable

    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrentNoDecidable prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

          WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) old := by
      intro w incoming old
      unfold chooseBetterForW WeaklyPrefers
      by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
      · simp [h]
      · simp [h]
    have choose_weak_incoming :
        ∀ (w : Woman) (incoming old : Man),
          WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) incoming := by
      intro w incoming old
      unfold chooseBetterForW WeaklyPrefers
      by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
      · simp [h]
      · simp [h]
        by_cases hEq : old = incoming
        · exact Or.inl hEq
        · have hNe : incoming ≠ old := by
            intro hio
            exact hEq hio.symm
          rcases prefW.total w hNe with hin | hold
          · exact False.elim (h hin)
          · exact Or.inr hold
    have step_preserves :
        ∀ {st next : ProposalState Man Woman} (proposer : Man),
          Inv st → ProposalStepRel prefW st proposer next → Inv next := by
      intro st next proposer hInv hStep
      rcases hInv with ⟨hOrd, hLow, hHeld, hBest⟩
      unfold ProposalStepRel at hStep
      rcases hStep with hNoop | hNoop | hProposal
      · rcases hNoop with ⟨_, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hOrd, hLow, hHeld, hBest⟩
      · rcases hNoop with ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hOrd, hLow, hHeld, hBest⟩
      · rcases hProposal with
          ⟨proposed, tail, hFree, hRem, hChange, hOtherHeld, hNextRem, hOtherRem⟩
        have hProposedNotTail : proposed ∉ tail := by
          intro hInTail
          have hThis := hOrd proposer
          rw [hRem] at hThis
          unfold ProposalListOrdered at hThis
          cases hThis with
          | cons hHead _ =>
              exact (prefM.irrefl proposer proposed) (hHead proposed hInTail)
        constructor
        · intro m
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            have hThis := hOrd proposer
            rw [hRem] at hThis
            rw [hNextRem]
            unfold ProposalListOrdered at hThis ⊢
            simpa using hThis.tail
          · rw [hOtherRem m hm]
            exact hOrd m
        constructor
        · intro m better worse hBetter hWorse hPref
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            rw [hNextRem] at hBetter ⊢
            have hBetterOld : better ∈ st.rem proposer := by
              rw [hRem]
              exact List.mem_cons_of_mem proposed hBetter
            have hWorseOld : worse ∈ st.rem proposer := hLow proposer hBetterOld hWorse hPref
            rw [hRem] at hWorseOld
            rcases (List.mem_cons.mp hWorseOld) with hWorseEq | hWorseTail
            · subst worse
              have hThis := hOrd proposer
              rw [hRem] at hThis
              unfold ProposalListOrdered at hThis
              cases hThis with
              | cons hHead _ =>
                  exact False.elim
                    ((prefM.irrefl proposer better) (prefM.trans proposer hPref (hHead better hBetter)))
            · exact hWorseTail
          · rw [hOtherRem m hm] at hBetter ⊢
            exact hLow m hBetter hWorse hPref
        constructor
        · intro m w hHeldNext
          by_cases hw : w = proposed
          · subst w
            rcases hChange with hVacant | hOccupied
            · rcases hVacant with ⟨_, hNextHeld⟩
              have hm : m = proposer := Option.some.inj (hHeldNext.symm.trans hNextHeld)
              subst m
              rw [hNextRem]
              exact hProposedNotTail
            · rcases hOccupied with ⟨old, hOldHeld, hNextHeld⟩
              have hmChoose : m = chooseBetterForW prefW proposed proposer old :=
                Option.some.inj (hHeldNext.symm.trans hNextHeld)
              unfold chooseBetterForW at hmChoose
              by_cases hPref : prefW.pref proposed proposer old
              · simp [hPref] at hmChoose
                subst m
                rw [hNextRem]
                exact hProposedNotTail
              · simp [hPref] at hmChoose
                subst m
                have hOldNe : old ≠ proposer := by
                  intro hOldEq
                  subst old
                  exact hFree proposed hOldHeld
                rw [hOtherRem old hOldNe]
                exact hHeld old proposed hOldHeld
          · have hHeldOld : st.matching.held w = some m := by
              rw [hOtherHeld w hw] at hHeldNext
              exact hHeldNext
            by_cases hm : m = proposer
            · subst m
              exact False.elim (hFree w hHeldOld)
            · rw [hOtherRem m hm]
              exact hHeld m w hHeldOld
        · intro m w hFull hNotRem
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            by_cases hw : w = proposed
            · subst w
              rcases hChange with hVacant | hOccupied
              · rcases hVacant with ⟨_, hNextHeld⟩
                exact ⟨proposer, hNextHeld, Or.inl rfl⟩
              · rcases hOccupied with ⟨old, _, hNextHeld⟩
                exact ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposed proposer old, hNextHeld,
                  choose_weak_incoming proposed proposer old⟩
            · have hOldNot : w ∉ st.rem proposer := by
                rw [hRem]
                intro hMem
                rcases (List.mem_cons.mp hMem) with hEq | hTail
                · exact hw hEq
                · rw [hNextRem] at hNotRem
                  exact hNotRem hTail
              rcases hBest proposer w hFull hOldNot with ⟨held, hHeldW, hWeak⟩
              have hNextHeld : next.matching.held w = some held := by
                rw [hOtherHeld w hw]
                exact hHeldW
              exact ⟨held, hNextHeld, hWeak⟩
          · have hOldNot : w ∉ st.rem m := by
              rw [hOtherRem m hm] at hNotRem
              exact hNotRem
            rcases hBest m w hFull hOldNot with ⟨held, hHeldW, hWeak⟩
            by_cases hw : w = proposed
            · subst w
              rcases hChange with hVacant | hOccupied
              · rcases hVacant with ⟨hOldNone, _⟩
                rw [hOldNone] at hHeldW
                cases hHeldW
              · rcases hOccupied with ⟨old, hOldHeld, hNextHeld⟩
                have hHeldEq : held = old := Option.some.inj (hHeldW.symm.trans hOldHeld)
                subst held
                exact ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposed proposer old, hNextHeld,
                  weak_trans proposed (chooseBetterForW prefW proposed proposer old) old m
                    (choose_weak_old proposed proposer old) hWeak⟩
            · have hNextHeld : next.matching.held w = some held := by
                rw [hOtherHeld w hw]
                exact hHeldW
              exact ⟨held, hNextHeld, hWeak⟩
    have inv_open : Inv (openingState fullList) := by
      constructor
      · intro m
        exact (hSound m).2
      constructor
      · intro m better worse _ hWorse _
        simpa [openingState] using hWorse
      constructor
      · intro m w hHeld
        simp [openingState, emptyMatching] at hHeld
      · intro m w hFull hNotRem
        exact False.elim (hNotRem (by simpa [openingState] using hFull))
    have run_preserves :
        ∀ {start finish : ProposalState Man Woman} {sched : List Man},
          ProposalRun prefW start sched finish → Inv start → Inv finish := by
      intro start finish sched hRun'
      induction hRun' with
      | nil st =>
          intro h
          exact h
      | cons hStep hTail ih =>
          intro h
          exact ih (step_preserves _ h hStep)
    have hInvState : Inv state := run_preserves hRun inv_open
    rcases hInvState with ⟨_, hLowState, hHeldState, hBestState⟩
    unfold Stable BlockingPair ManPrefersCurrent
    intro m w hBlock
    rcases hBlock with ⟨hMan, hWoman⟩
    cases hPartner : partnerOfMan state.matching m with
    | none =>
        have hFree : freeMan state.matching m := by
          intro w' hHeld
          have hExists : ∃ w' : Woman, state.matching.held w' = some m := ⟨w', hHeld⟩
          unfold partnerOfMan at hPartner
          simp [hExists] at hPartner
        have hRemEmpty : state.rem m = [] := hQuiet m hFree
        have hNotRem : w ∉ state.rem m := by
          rw [hRemEmpty]
          simp
        rcases hBestState m w (hComplete m w) hNotRem with ⟨held, hHeldW, hWeak⟩
        rw [hHeldW] at hWoman
        exact weak_strict_false w held m hWeak hWoman
    | some partner =>
        have hHeldPartner : state.matching.held partner = some m := by
          unfold partnerOfMan at hPartner
          by_cases hExists : ∃ w' : Woman, state.matching.held w' = some m
          · simp [hExists] at hPartner
            have hChooseEq : Classical.choose hExists = partner := by
              simpa using hPartner
            rw [← hChooseEq]
            exact Classical.choose_spec hExists
          · simp [hExists] at hPartner
        simp [hPartner] at hMan
        have hPartnerNotRem : partner ∉ state.rem m := hHeldState m partner hHeldPartner
        have hWNotRem : w ∉ state.rem m := by
          intro hWRem
          exact hPartnerNotRem (hLowState m hWRem (hComplete m partner) hMan)
        rcases hBestState m w (hComplete m w) hWNotRem with ⟨held, hHeldW, hWeak⟩
        rw [hHeldW] at hWoman
        exact weak_strict_false w held m hWeak hWoman
  · let prefM : StrictPreference PUnit.{u + 1} PUnit.{v + 1} :=
      { pref := fun _ _ _ => False
        decidablePref := fun _ _ _ => isFalse id
        irrefl := by
          intro _ _ h
          exact h
        trans := by
          intro _ _ _ _ h _
          exact False.elim h
        total := by
          intro _ x y hxy
          cases x
          cases y
          exact False.elim (hxy rfl) }
    let prefW : StrictPreference PUnit.{v + 1} PUnit.{u + 1} :=
      { pref := fun _ _ _ => False
        decidablePref := fun _ _ _ => isFalse id
        irrefl := by
          intro _ _ h
          exact h
        trans := by
          intro _ _ _ _ h _
          exact False.elim h
        total := by
          intro _ x y hxy
          cases x
          cases y
          exact False.elim (hxy rfl) }
    let fullList : PUnit.{u + 1} → List PUnit.{v + 1} := fun _ => [PUnit.unit]
    refine ⟨PUnit.{u + 1}, PUnit.{v + 1}, ⟨inferInstance⟩, ⟨inferInstance⟩,
      prefM, prefW, fullList, [], openingState fullList, PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro m
      cases m
      constructor
      · simp [fullList]
      · simp [ProposalListOrdered, fullList]
    constructor
    · intro m w
      cases m
      cases w
      simp [fullList]
    constructor
    · exact ProposalRun.nil (openingState fullList)
    constructor
    · intro w h
      cases w
      simp [openingState, emptyMatching] at h
    constructor
    · simp [openingState, fullList]
    constructor
    · intro hQuietState
      have hFree : FreeManIn (openingState fullList).matching PUnit.unit := by
        intro w h
        cases w
        simp [openingState, emptyMatching] at h
      have hEmpty := hQuietState PUnit.unit hFree
      simp [openingState, fullList] at hEmpty
    · constructor
      · unfold ManPrefersCurrentNoDecidable ManPrefersOption partnerOfMan
        simp [openingState, emptyMatching]
      · unfold WomanPrefersOption
        simp [openingState, emptyMatching]

by
  intro Man Woman _ _ _ _ prefW fullList schedule state hRun
  let Good (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
    ∀ {m : Man} {w : Woman},
      w ∈ fullList m →
        w ∉ state.rem m →
          state.matching.held w = some m ∨
            ∃ held : Man, state.matching.held w = some held ∧ prefW.pref w held m
  have step_preserves :
      ∀ (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man),
        Good state → Good (proposalStep prefW state proposer) := by
    intro state proposer hGood
    intro m w hMem hNotRem
    by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
    · cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
      | nil =>
          simpa [Good, proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using
            (hGood hMem (by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using hNotRem))
      | cons head tail =>
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            by_cases hInOldRem : w ∈ state.rem proposer
            · have hw_head_or_tail : w = head ∨ w ∈ tail := by
                simpa [hrem] using hInOldRem
              rcases hw_head_or_tail with hw_head | hw_tail
              · subst w
                cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
                | none =>
                    left
                    simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld]
                | some old =>
                    by_cases hp : prefW.pref head proposer old
                    · left
                      simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                    · right
                      refine ⟨old, ?_, ?_⟩
                      · simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      · have hne_old : old ≠ proposer := by
                          intro hold
                          exact hfree head (by simpa [hold] using hheld)
                        have hne : proposer ≠ old := hne_old.symm
                        rcases prefW.total head hne with hproposer_old | hold_proposer
                        · exact False.elim (hp hproposer_old)
                        · exact hold_proposer
              · exact False.elim (hNotRem (by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using hw_tail))
            · have hw_ne : w ≠ head := by
                intro hw
                exact hInOldRem (by simp [hrem, hw])
              have hOld := hGood hMem hInOldRem
              cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
              | none =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
              | some old =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
          · have hNotOldRem : w ∉ state.rem m := by
              intro hOldMem
              exact hNotRem (by
                simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, Function.update, hm] using hOldMem)
            have hOld := hGood hMem hNotOldRem
            by_cases hw_head : w = head
            · subst w
              cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
              | none =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · simp [hheld] at hHeld
                  · simp [hheld] at hHeld
              | some old =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · have hold_eq_m : old = m :=
                      Option.some.inj (hheld.symm.trans hHeld)
                    by_cases hp : prefW.pref head proposer old
                    · right
                      refine ⟨proposer, ?_, ?_⟩
                      · simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      · simpa [hold_eq_m] using hp
                    · left
                      have hnext :
                          (proposalStep prefW state proposer).matching.held head = some old := by
                        simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      simpa [hold_eq_m] using hnext
                  · have hheld_eq_old : held = old :=
                      Option.some.inj (hHeld.symm.trans hheld)
                    have hold_pref_m : prefW.pref head old m := by
                      simpa [hheld_eq_old] using hpref
                    by_cases hp : prefW.pref head proposer old
                    · right
                      refine ⟨proposer, ?_, ?_⟩
                      · simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      · exact prefW.trans head hp hold_pref_m
                    · right
                      refine ⟨old, ?_, hold_pref_m⟩
                      simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
            · cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
              | none =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
              | some old =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
    · simpa [Good, proposalStep, hfree] using
        (hGood hMem (by simpa [proposalStep, hfree] using hNotRem))
  have post_preserves :
      ∀ (schedule : List Man) (state : ProposalState Man Woman),
        Good state → Good (postProposals prefW state schedule) := by
    intro schedule
    induction schedule with
    | nil =>
        intro state hGood m w hMem hNotRem
        exact hGood hMem (by simpa [postProposals] using hNotRem)
    | cons proposer schedule ih =>
        intro state hGood
        exact ih (proposalStep prefW state proposer) (step_preserves state proposer hGood)
  have hInitial : Good (openingState fullList : ProposalState Man Woman) := by
    intro m w hMem hNotRem
    exact False.elim (hNotRem (by simpa [openingState] using hMem))
  have hPost : Good (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule) :=
    post_preserves schedule (openingState fullList) hInitial
  have hEq : postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state := by
    simpa [ProposalRun] using hRun
  rw [← hEq]
  intro m w hMem hNotRem
  exact hPost hMem hNotRem

namespace GaleShapleyStableMatchingFormalizeProbe

universe u v

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

                                             

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

                                                                                   

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)
        { matching := { held := updateHeld state.matching.held w nextHeld }
          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  postProposals prefW initial schedule = state

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

theorem iso_lemma1 : ∀ {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}
      [Fintype Man] [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
      (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
      (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man)
      (state : ProposalState Man Woman),
      ProposalRun prefW (openingState fullList) schedule state →
        ∀ {m : Man} {w : Woman},
          w ∈ fullList m →
            w ∉ state.rem m →
              state.matching.held w = some m ∨
                ∃ held : Man, state.matching.held w = some held ∧ prefW.pref w held m := by
  intro Man Woman _ _ _ _ prefW fullList schedule state hRun
  let Good (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
    ∀ {m : Man} {w : Woman},
      w ∈ fullList m →
        w ∉ state.rem m →
          state.matching.held w = some m ∨
            ∃ held : Man, state.matching.held w = some held ∧ prefW.pref w held m
  have step_preserves :
      ∀ (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man),
        Good state → Good (proposalStep prefW state proposer) := by
    intro state proposer hGood
    intro m w hMem hNotRem
    by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
    · cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
      | nil =>
          simpa [Good, proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using
            (hGood hMem (by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using hNotRem))
      | cons head tail =>
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            by_cases hInOldRem : w ∈ state.rem proposer
            · have hw_head_or_tail : w = head ∨ w ∈ tail := by
                simpa [hrem] using hInOldRem
              rcases hw_head_or_tail with hw_head | hw_tail
              · subst w
                cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
                | none =>
                    left
                    simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld]
                | some old =>
                    by_cases hp : prefW.pref head proposer old
                    · left
                      simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                    · right
                      refine ⟨old, ?_, ?_⟩
                      · simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      · have hne_old : old ≠ proposer := by
                          intro hold
                          exact hfree head (by simpa [hold] using hheld)
                        have hne : proposer ≠ old := hne_old.symm
                        rcases prefW.total head hne with hproposer_old | hold_proposer
                        · exact False.elim (hp hproposer_old)
                        · exact hold_proposer
              · exact False.elim (hNotRem (by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using hw_tail))
            · have hw_ne : w ≠ head := by
                intro hw
                exact hInOldRem (by simp [hrem, hw])
              have hOld := hGood hMem hInOldRem
              cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
              | none =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
              | some old =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_ne] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
          · have hNotOldRem : w ∉ state.rem m := by
              intro hOldMem
              exact hNotRem (by
                simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, Function.update, hm] using hOldMem)
            have hOld := hGood hMem hNotOldRem
            by_cases hw_head : w = head
            · subst w
              cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
              | none =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · simp [hheld] at hHeld
                  · simp [hheld] at hHeld
              | some old =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · have hold_eq_m : old = m :=
                      Option.some.inj (hheld.symm.trans hHeld)
                    by_cases hp : prefW.pref head proposer old
                    · right
                      refine ⟨proposer, ?_, ?_⟩
                      · simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      · simpa [hold_eq_m] using hp
                    · left
                      have hnext :
                          (proposalStep prefW state proposer).matching.held head = some old := by
                        simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      simpa [hold_eq_m] using hnext
                  · have hheld_eq_old : held = old :=
                      Option.some.inj (hHeld.symm.trans hheld)
                    have hold_pref_m : prefW.pref head old m := by
                      simpa [hheld_eq_old] using hpref
                    by_cases hp : prefW.pref head proposer old
                    · right
                      refine ⟨proposer, ?_, ?_⟩
                      · simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
                      · exact prefW.trans head hp hold_pref_m
                    · right
                      refine ⟨old, ?_, hold_pref_m⟩
                      simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hp]
            · cases hheld : state.matching.held head with
              | none =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
              | some old =>
                  rcases hOld with hHeld | ⟨held, hHeld, hpref⟩
                  · left
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld
                  · right
                    exact ⟨held,
                      by simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw_head] using hHeld,
                      hpref⟩
    · simpa [Good, proposalStep, hfree] using
        (hGood hMem (by simpa [proposalStep, hfree] using hNotRem))
  have post_preserves :
      ∀ (schedule : List Man) (state : ProposalState Man Woman),
        Good state → Good (postProposals prefW state schedule) := by
    intro schedule
    induction schedule with
    | nil =>
        intro state hGood m w hMem hNotRem
        exact hGood hMem (by simpa [postProposals] using hNotRem)
    | cons proposer schedule ih =>
        intro state hGood
        exact ih (proposalStep prefW state proposer) (step_preserves state proposer hGood)
  have hInitial : Good (openingState fullList : ProposalState Man Woman) := by
    intro m w hMem hNotRem
    exact False.elim (hNotRem (by simpa [openingState] using hMem))
  have hPost : Good (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule) :=
    post_preserves schedule (openingState fullList) hInitial
  have hEq : postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state := by
    simpa [ProposalRun] using hRun
  rw [← hEq]
  intro m w hMem hNotRem
  exact hPost hMem hNotRem

namespace GaleShapleyStableMatchingFormalizeProbe

universe u v

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

                                             

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

                                                                                   

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if _hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)
        { matching := { held := updateHeld state.matching.held w nextHeld }
          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  postProposals prefW initial schedule = state

  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

universe u v

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

                                             

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

                                                                                   

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)
        { matching := { held := updateHeld state.matching.held w nextHeld }
          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  postProposals prefW initial schedule = state

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

  intro m w hBlock
  rcases hBlock with ⟨hMan, hWoman⟩
  have hNotRem : w ∉ state.rem m :=
    preferred_candidate_removed_from_remainder prefM prefW fullList schedule
      hSound hRun hQuiet hComplete m w hMan
  have hRespAll := postProposals_response_invariant prefW fullList schedule
  have hRunEq : postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state := by
    simpa [ProposalRun] using hRun
  have hRespState :
      ∀ m, ∃ proposed, fullList m = proposed ++ state.rem m ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
          ∃ held, state.matching.held w = some held ∧ WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
    simpa [hRunEq] using hRespAll
  rcases hRespState m with ⟨proposed, hFull, hResp⟩
  have hMemFull : w ∈ fullList m := hComplete m w
  have hMemProposed : w ∈ proposed := by
    rw [hFull, List.mem_append] at hMemFull
    rcases hMemFull with hLeft | hRight
    · exact hLeft
    · exact False.elim (hNotRem hRight)
  rcases hResp w hMemProposed with ⟨held, hHeld, hWeak⟩
  rw [hHeld] at hWoman
  rcases hWeak with hEq | hHeldPref
