set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

namespace GaleShapleyStableMatchingFormalizeProbe

universe u v

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

/-- The opening state: nobody is held, and every man has his full proposal list. -/

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)
        { matching := { held := updateHeld state.matching.held w nextHeld }
          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  postProposals prefW initial schedule = state

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

private theorem pairwise_rel_of_mem_left_mem_right {α : Type*} {R : α → α → Prop}
    {left right : List α} (h : (left ++ right).Pairwise R)
    {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ left) (hb : b ∈ right) : R a b := by
  induction left with
  | nil =>
      simp at ha
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [List.cons_append] at h
      cases h with
      | cons hhead htail =>
          simp only [List.mem_cons] at ha
          rcases ha with rfl | ha
          · exact hhead b (by simp [hb])
          · exact ih htail ha

private theorem weaklyPrefers_trans
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) {agent : Agent} {a b c : Alt}
    (hab : WeaklyPrefers prefs agent b a)
    (hbc : WeaklyPrefers prefs agent c b) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefs agent c a := by
  rcases hbc with rfl | hcb
  · exact hab
  · rcases hab with rfl | hba
    · exact Or.inr hcb
    · exact Or.inr (prefs.trans agent hcb hba)

private theorem chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (incoming old : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) old := by
  unfold WeaklyPrefers chooseBetterForW
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w incoming old) :=
    prefW.decidablePref w incoming old
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

private theorem chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_incoming
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (incoming old : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) incoming := by
  unfold chooseBetterForW
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w incoming old) :=
    prefW.decidablePref w incoming old
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
  · simp [h, WeaklyPrefers]
  · by_cases heq : old = incoming
    · simp [h, heq, WeaklyPrefers]
    · have htotal := prefW.total w (Ne.symm heq)
      rcases htotal with hio | hoi
      · exact False.elim (h hio)
      · simp [h, WeaklyPrefers, hoi]

private theorem proposalStep_rem_suffix
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (fullList : Man → List Woman)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man)
    (hSuffix : ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ state.rem m) :
    ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ (proposalStep prefW state proposer).rem m := by
  intro m
  unfold proposalStep
  by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
  · simp [hfree]
    cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
    | nil =>
        simp
        exact hSuffix m
    | cons w tail =>
        simp
        by_cases hm : m = proposer
        · subst m
          obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffix proposer
          refine ⟨prefList ++ [w], ?_⟩
          rw [hprefList, hrem]
          simp
        · obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffix m
          refine ⟨prefList, ?_⟩
          simpa [Function.update, hm] using hprefList
  · simp [hfree]
    exact hSuffix m

private theorem proposalStep_held_removed
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man)
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList)
    (hSuffix : ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ state.rem m)
    (hRemoved : ∀ m w, state.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ state.rem m) :
    ∀ m w, (proposalStep prefW state proposer).matching.held w = some m →
      w ∉ (proposalStep prefW state proposer).rem m := by
  intro m w hheld hmem
  unfold proposalStep at hheld hmem
  by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
  · simp [hfree] at hheld hmem
    cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
    | nil =>
        simp [hrem] at hheld hmem
        exact hRemoved m w hheld hmem
    | cons proposed tail =>
        simp [hrem] at hheld hmem
        by_cases hw : w = proposed
        · subst w
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffix proposer
            have hNodupFull : (fullList proposer).Nodup := (hSound proposer).1
            have hNodupRem : (proposed :: tail).Nodup := by
              rw [hprefList, hrem] at hNodupFull
              exact hNodupFull.of_append_right
            have hnotTail : proposed ∉ tail := by
              have hNodupCons : proposed ∉ tail ∧ tail.Nodup := by
                simpa using hNodupRem
              exact hNodupCons.1
            have hmemTail : proposed ∈ tail := by
              simpa [Function.update] using hmem
            exact hnotTail hmemTail
          · have hOldHeld : state.matching.held proposed = some m := by
              cases hstateHeld : state.matching.held proposed with
              | none =>
                  have hmprop : m = proposer := by
                    have hsome : some m = some proposer := by
                      simpa [updateHeld, hstateHeld] using hheld.symm
                    exact Option.some.inj hsome
                  exact (hm hmprop).elim
              | some old =>
                  by_cases hbetter : prefW.pref proposed proposer old
                  · have hmprop : m = proposer := by
                      have hsome : some m = some proposer := by
                        simpa [updateHeld, hstateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hbetter] using hheld.symm
                      exact Option.some.inj hsome
                    exact (hm hmprop).elim
                  · have holdm : old = m := by
                      have hsome : some old = some m := by
                        simpa [updateHeld, hstateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hbetter] using hheld
                      exact Option.some.inj hsome
                    simp [holdm]
            have hmemOld : proposed ∈ state.rem m := by
              by_cases hm' : m = proposer
              · exact (hm hm').elim
              · simpa [Function.update, hm'] using hmem
            exact hRemoved m proposed hOldHeld hmemOld
        · have hOldHeld : state.matching.held w = some m := by
            unfold updateHeld at hheld
            simpa [hw] using hheld
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            exact hfree w hOldHeld
          · have hmemOld : w ∈ state.rem m := by
              simpa [Function.update, hm] using hmem
            exact hRemoved m w hOldHeld hmemOld
  · simp [hfree] at hheld hmem
    exact hRemoved m w hheld hmem

private theorem postProposals_invariants
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList) :
    (∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m =
      prefList ++ (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).rem m) ∧
    (∀ m w,
      (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).matching.held w = some m →
        w ∉ (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).rem m) := by
  have hGeneral :
      ∀ (start : ProposalState Man Woman) (sched : List Man),
        (∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ start.rem m) →
        (∀ m w, start.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ start.rem m) →
        (∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m =
          prefList ++ (postProposals prefW start sched).rem m) ∧
        (∀ m w, (postProposals prefW start sched).matching.held w = some m →
          w ∉ (postProposals prefW start sched).rem m) := by
    intro start sched
    induction sched generalizing start with
    | nil =>
        intro hSuffix hRemoved
        simp [postProposals]
        exact ⟨hSuffix, hRemoved⟩
    | cons proposer rest ih =>
        intro hSuffix hRemoved
        simp [postProposals]
        let mid := proposalStep prefW start proposer
        have hMidSuffix : ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ mid.rem m := by
          exact proposalStep_rem_suffix prefW fullList start proposer hSuffix
        have hMidRemoved : ∀ m w, mid.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ mid.rem m := by
          exact proposalStep_held_removed prefM prefW fullList start proposer
            hSound hSuffix hRemoved
        simpa [mid, postProposals] using ih mid hMidSuffix hMidRemoved
  have hInitSuffix :
      ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ (openingState fullList).rem m := by
    intro m
    exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  have hInitRemoved :
      ∀ m w, (openingState fullList).matching.held w = some m →
        w ∉ (openingState fullList).rem m := by
    intro m w hheld
    simp [openingState, emptyMatching] at hheld
  exact hGeneral (openingState fullList) schedule hInitSuffix hInitRemoved

private theorem preferred_candidate_removed_from_remainder
    [Fintype Man] [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man) {state : ProposalState Man Woman}
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList)
    (hRun : ProposalRun prefW (openingState fullList) schedule state)
    (hQuiet : Quiescent state)
    (hComplete : ∀ m w, w ∈ fullList m) :
    ∀ m w, ManPrefersCurrent prefM state.matching m w → w ∉ state.rem m := by
  intro m w hPref hmem
  have hInv := postProposals_invariants prefM prefW fullList schedule hSound
  have hRunEq : postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state := by
    simpa [ProposalRun] using hRun
  have hSuffixState :
      ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ state.rem m := by
    simpa [hRunEq] using hInv.1
  have hRemovedState :
      ∀ m w, state.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ state.rem m := by
    simpa [hRunEq] using hInv.2
  unfold ManPrefersCurrent at hPref
  unfold partnerOfMan at hPref
  by_cases hexists : ∃ wCurrent : Woman, state.matching.held wCurrent = some m
  · simp [hexists] at hPref
    let wCurrent : Woman := Classical.choose hexists
    have hHeldCurrent : state.matching.held wCurrent = some m :=
      Classical.choose_spec hexists
    have hCurrentNotMem : wCurrent ∉ state.rem m :=
      hRemovedState m wCurrent hHeldCurrent
    obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffixState m
    have hCurrentMemFull : wCurrent ∈ fullList m := hComplete m wCurrent
    have hCurrentMemPrefix : wCurrent ∈ prefList := by
      rw [hprefList, List.mem_append] at hCurrentMemFull
      rcases hCurrentMemFull with hcur | hcur
      · exact hcur
      · exact (hCurrentNotMem hcur).elim
    have hOrdered : ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m) := (hSound m).2
    have hCurrentPrefersW : prefM.pref m wCurrent w := by
      rw [hprefList] at hOrdered
      exact pairwise_rel_of_mem_left_mem_right hOrdered hCurrentMemPrefix hmem
    have hPrefers : prefM.pref m w wCurrent := by
      simpa [wCurrent] using hPref
    exact (prefM.irrefl m w) (prefM.trans m hPrefers hCurrentPrefersW)
  · have hfree : freeMan state.matching m := by
      intro w0 hheld
      exact hexists ⟨w0, hheld⟩
    have hremEmpty : state.rem m = [] := hQuiet m hfree
    simp [hremEmpty] at hmem

private theorem proposalStep_response_invariant
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (fullList : Man → List Woman)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man)
    (hInv : ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
      fullList m = proposed ++ state.rem m ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
          ∃ held, state.matching.held w = some held ∧ WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m) :
    ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
      fullList m = proposed ++ (proposalStep prefW state proposer).rem m ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
          ∃ held, (proposalStep prefW state proposer).matching.held w = some held ∧
            WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
  intro m
  unfold proposalStep
  by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
  · simp [hfree]
    cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
    | nil =>
        simp
        exact hInv m
    | cons proposedWoman tail =>
        simp
        by_cases hm : m = proposer
        · subst m
          rcases hInv proposer with ⟨already, hFull, hResp⟩
          refine ⟨already ++ [proposedWoman], ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hFull, hrem]
            simp
          · intro w hw
            have hwCases := List.mem_append.mp hw
            rcases hwCases with hwAlready | hwLast
            · rcases hResp w hwAlready with ⟨held, hHeld, hWeak⟩
              by_cases hwEq : w = proposedWoman
              · subst w
                cases hOld : state.matching.held proposedWoman with
                | none =>
                    exact False.elim (by simpa [hOld] using hHeld)
                | some old =>
                    have hheldEq : held = old := by
                      exact Option.some.inj (hHeld.symm.trans hOld)
                    subst held
                    refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposedWoman proposer old, ?_, ?_⟩
                    · simp [updateHeld, hOld]
                    · exact weaklyPrefers_trans prefW hWeak
                        (chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old prefW proposedWoman proposer old)
              · refine ⟨held, ?_, hWeak⟩
                simp [updateHeld, hwEq]
                exact hHeld
            · have hwEq : w = proposedWoman := by
                simpa using hwLast
              subst w
              cases hOld : state.matching.held proposedWoman with
              | none =>
                  refine ⟨proposer, ?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
                  simp [updateHeld, hOld]
              | some old =>
                  refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposedWoman proposer old, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · simp [updateHeld, hOld]
                  · exact chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_incoming prefW proposedWoman proposer old
        · rcases hInv m with ⟨already, hFull, hResp⟩
          refine ⟨already, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa [Function.update, hm] using hFull
          · intro w hw
            rcases hResp w hw with ⟨held, hHeld, hWeak⟩
            by_cases hwEq : w = proposedWoman
            · subst w
              cases hOld : state.matching.held proposedWoman with
              | none =>
                  exact False.elim (by simpa [hOld] using hHeld)
              | some old =>
                  have hheldEq : held = old := by
                    exact Option.some.inj (hHeld.symm.trans hOld)
                  subst held
                  refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposedWoman proposer old, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · simp [updateHeld, hOld]
                  · exact weaklyPrefers_trans prefW hWeak
                      (chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old prefW proposedWoman proposer old)
            · refine ⟨held, ?_, hWeak⟩
              simp [updateHeld, hwEq]
              exact hHeld
  · simp [hfree]
    exact hInv m

private theorem postProposals_response_invariant
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man) :
    ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
      fullList m =
        proposed ++ (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).rem m ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
          ∃ held,
            (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).matching.held w =
                some held ∧
              WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
  have hGeneral :
      ∀ (start : ProposalState Man Woman) (sched : List Man),
        (∀ m, ∃ proposed, fullList m = proposed ++ start.rem m ∧
          ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
            ∃ held, start.matching.held w = some held ∧
              WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m) →
        ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
          fullList m = proposed ++ (postProposals prefW start sched).rem m ∧
            ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
              ∃ held, (postProposals prefW start sched).matching.held w = some held ∧
                WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
    intro start sched
    induction sched generalizing start with
    | nil =>
        intro hInv
        simpa [postProposals] using hInv
    | cons proposer rest ih =>
        intro hInv
        simp [postProposals]
        let mid := proposalStep prefW start proposer
        have hMid :
            ∀ m, ∃ proposed, fullList m = proposed ++ mid.rem m ∧
              ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
                ∃ held, mid.matching.held w = some held ∧
                  WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
          exact proposalStep_response_invariant prefW fullList start proposer hInv
        simpa [mid, postProposals] using ih mid hMid

abbrev Grid := List (List Nat)
abbrev Cell := Nat × Nat

def cellAt (g : Grid) (y x : Nat) : Nat := (g.getD y []).getD x 0

def gridMap (g : Grid) (f : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat) : Grid :=
  (List.range g.length).map fun y =>
    (List.range ((g.getD y []).length)).map fun x => f y x (cellAt g y x)

def recolorMap (g : Grid) (m : List (Nat × Nat)) : Grid :=
  gridMap g fun _ _ c => ((m.find? (fun p => p.1 == c)).map Prod.snd).getD c

def consumeRowExtremal (g : Grid) (color repl : Nat) (useMin : Bool) : Grid :=
  g.map fun row =>
    let idxs := (List.range row.length).filter (fun x => row.getD x 0 == color)
    match (if useMin then idxs.head? else idxs.getLast?) with
    | none => row
    | some k => (List.range row.length).map fun x => if x = k then repl else row.getD x 0

def countColor (g : Grid) (c : Nat) : Nat :=
  (g.map (fun row => (row.filter (fun v => v == c)).length)).foldl (· + ·) 0

def consumeRowExtremalK (g : Grid) (color repl : Nat) (useMin : Bool) : Nat → Grid
  | 0 => g
  | Nat.succ k => consumeRowExtremalK (consumeRowExtremal g color repl useMin) color repl useMin k

def adj (a b : Cell) : Bool :=
  ((a.1 == b.1) && (a.2 + 1 == b.2 || b.2 + 1 == a.2)) ||
  ((a.2 == b.2) && (a.1 + 1 == b.1 || b.1 + 1 == a.1))

def growOnce (comp rest : List Cell) : List Cell × List Cell :=
  let added := rest.filter (fun c => comp.any (fun k => adj k c))
  (comp ++ added, rest.filter (fun c => ! comp.any (fun k => adj k c)))

def component (seed : Cell) (cells : List Cell) (fuel : Nat) : List Cell :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => [seed]
  | Nat.succ f =>
    let rec go (n : Nat) (comp rest : List Cell) : List Cell :=
      match n with
      | 0 => comp
      | Nat.succ m =>
        let (c2, r2) := growOnce comp rest
        if c2.length = comp.length then comp else go m c2 r2
    go (Nat.succ f) [seed] (cells.filter (fun c => c ≠ seed))

def matchCells (g : Grid) (colors : List Nat) : List Cell :=
  ((List.range g.length).map fun y =>
    ((List.range ((g.getD y []).length)).filter
      (fun x => colors.contains (cellAt g y x))).map (fun x => (y, x))).flatten

def componentsOf (g : Grid) (colors : List Nat) : List (List Cell) :=
  let cells := matchCells g colors
  let rec go (n : Nat) (remaining : List Cell) (acc : List (List Cell)) : List (List Cell) :=
    match n, remaining with
    | 0, _ => acc
    | _, [] => acc
    | Nat.succ m, seed :: _ =>
      let comp := component seed remaining remaining.length
      go m (remaining.filter (fun c => ! comp.contains c)) (acc ++ [comp])

        · have hz' : z ∈ (growOnce comp rest).2 := by simpa [hgr] using hz

lemma component_go_subset {base comp rest : List Cell}
    (hcomp : ∀ c, c ∈ comp → c ∈ base)
    (hrest : ∀ c, c ∈ rest → c ∈ base) :
    ∀ n c, c ∈ component.go n comp rest → c ∈ base := by
  intro n
  induction n generalizing comp rest with
  | zero =>
      intro c hc
      simpa [component.go] using hcomp c hc
  | succ m ih =>
      intro c hc
      unfold component.go at hc
      rcases hgr : growOnce comp rest with ⟨c2, r2⟩
      simp only [hgr] at hc
      by_cases hlen : c2.length = comp.length
      · simp [hlen] at hc
        exact hcomp c hc
      · simp [hlen] at hc
        refine ih
          (fun z hz => ?_)
          (fun z hz => ?_)
          c hc
        · have hz' : z ∈ (growOnce comp rest).1 := by simpa [hgr] using hz
          exact (growOnce_fst_mem hz').elim (hcomp z) (hrest z)
        · have hz' : z ∈ (growOnce comp rest).2 := by simpa [hgr] using hz
          exact hrest z (growOnce_snd_mem hz')

lemma component_subset_of_seed_mem {seed : Cell} {cells : List Cell}
    (hseed : seed ∈ cells) :
    ∀ fuel c, c ∈ component seed cells fuel → c ∈ cells := by
  intro fuel
  cases fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro c hc
      simp [component] at hc
      simpa [hc] using hseed
  | succ f =>
      intro c hc
      have hgo :
          c ∈ component.go (Nat.succ f) [seed] (cells.filter (fun c => c ≠ seed)) := by
        simpa [component] using hc
      exact component_go_subset
        (base := cells) (comp := [seed]) (rest := cells.filter (fun c => c ≠ seed))
        (by
          intro z hz
          have hzseed : z = seed := by simpa using hz
          simpa [hzseed] using hseed)
        (by intro z hz; exact (List.mem_filter.mp hz).1)
        (Nat.succ f) c hgo

def componentsOfGo (g : Grid) (colors : List Nat) :
    Nat → List Cell → List (List Cell) → List (List Cell)
  | 0, _remaining, acc => acc
  | _, [], acc => acc
  | Nat.succ m, remaining@(seed :: _), acc =>
    let comp := component seed remaining remaining.length
    componentsOfGo g colors m (remaining.filter (fun c => ! comp.contains c)) (acc ++ [comp])

lemma componentsOfGo_subset {g : Grid} {colors : List Nat} {base remaining : List Cell}
    {acc : List (List Cell)}
    (hrem : ∀ c, c ∈ remaining → c ∈ base)
    (hacc : ∀ comp, comp ∈ acc → ∀ c, c ∈ comp → c ∈ base) :
    ∀ n comp, comp ∈ componentsOfGo g colors n remaining acc →
      ∀ c, c ∈ comp → c ∈ base := by
  intro n
  induction n generalizing remaining acc with
  | zero =>
      intro comp hcomp c hc
      simpa [componentsOfGo] using hacc comp hcomp c hc
  | succ m ih =>
      intro comp hcomp c hc
      cases remaining with
      | nil =>
          simpa [componentsOfGo] using hacc comp hcomp c hc
      | cons seed rest =>
          unfold componentsOfGo at hcomp
          refine ih
            (fun z hz => ?_)
            (fun comp' hcomp' z hz' => ?_)
            comp hcomp c hc
          · exact hrem z (List.mem_filter.mp hz).1
          · have hmem : comp' ∈ acc ∨ comp' = component seed (seed :: rest) (seed :: rest).length := by
              simpa [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] using hcomp'
            cases hmem with
            | inl hleft => exact hacc comp' hleft z hz'
            | inr hright =>
                subst comp'
                exact hrem z (component_subset_of_seed_mem (by simp) _ z hz')

lemma componentsOf_go_subset {g : Grid} {colors : List Nat} {base remaining : List Cell}
    {acc : List (List Cell)}
    (hrem : ∀ c, c ∈ remaining → c ∈ base)
    (hacc : ∀ comp, comp ∈ acc → ∀ c, c ∈ comp → c ∈ base) :
    ∀ n comp, comp ∈ componentsOf.go n remaining acc →
      ∀ c, c ∈ comp → c ∈ base := by

  induction n generalizing remaining acc with
  | zero =>
      intro comp hcomp c hc
      simpa [componentsOf.go] using hacc comp hcomp c hc
  | succ m ih =>

      cases remaining with
      | nil =>

      | cons seed rest =>
          unfold componentsOf.go at hcomp
          refine ih
            (fun z hz => ?_)
            (fun comp' hcomp' z hz' => ?_)
            comp hcomp c hc
          · exact hrem z (List.mem_filter.mp hz).1
          · have hmem : comp' ∈ acc ∨ comp' = component seed (seed :: rest) (seed :: rest).length := by
              simpa [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] using hcomp'

            | inl hleft => exact hacc comp' hleft z hz'

lemma componentOf_mem_matchCells {g : Grid} {colors : List Nat} {comp : List Cell}
    (hcomp : comp ∈ componentsOf g colors) :
    ∀ c, c ∈ comp → c ∈ matchCells g colors := by
  have h :
      comp ∈ componentsOf.go (matchCells g colors).length (matchCells g colors) [] := by
    simpa [componentsOf] using hcomp
  exact componentsOf_go_subset (g := g) (colors := colors)
    (base := matchCells g colors) (remaining := matchCells g colors) (acc := [])
    (by intro c hc; exact hc)
    (by intro comp hcomp; simp at hcomp)
    (matchCells g colors).length comp h

lemma movedSrc_mem_matchCells {g : Grid} {colors destOk : List Nat} {dy dx : Int}
    {minColors : Nat} {c : Cell}
    (hc : c ∈ ((componentsOf g colors).filter
      (fun comp => compOk g comp dy dx destOk minColors)).flatten) :
    c ∈ matchCells g colors := by
  rw [List.mem_flatten] at hc
  rcases hc with ⟨comp, hcomp, hcin⟩
  exact componentOf_mem_matchCells (List.mem_of_mem_filter hcomp) c hcin

lemma matchCells_mem_color {g : Grid} {colors : List Nat} {c : Cell}
    (hc : c ∈ matchCells g colors) : cellAt g c.1 c.2 ∈ colors := by
  unfold matchCells at hc
  rw [List.mem_flatten] at hc
  rcases hc with ⟨rowCells, hrow, hcell⟩
  rcases List.mem_map.mp hrow with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rcases List.mem_map.mp hcell with ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
  rcases hxy
  exact (List.contains_iff_mem.mp (List.mem_filter.mp hx).2)

lemma cellAt_gridMap {g : Grid} {f : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat} {y x : Nat}
    (hy : y < g.length) (hx : x < (g.getD y []).length) :
    cellAt (gridMap g f) y x = f y x (cellAt g y x) := by
  unfold cellAt gridMap
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem
    (l := (List.range g.length).map fun y =>
      (List.range ((g.getD y []).length)).map fun x => f y x (cellAt g y x))
    (d := []) (by simpa using hy)]
  simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, List.length_range]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem
    (l := (List.range ((g.getD y []).length)).map fun x => f y x (cellAt g y x))
    (d := 0) (by simpa using hx)]
  simp [cellAt]

lemma gridMap_row_length (g : Grid) (f : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat) (y : Nat)
    (hy : y < g.length) :
    ((gridMap g f).getD y []).length = (g.getD y []).length := by
  unfold gridMap
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem
    (l := (List.range g.length).map fun y =>
      (List.range ((g.getD y []).length)).map fun x => f y x (cellAt g y x))
    (d := []) (by simpa using hy)]
  simp

lemma translateBlock_cell_target_imp (g : Grid) (colors destOk : List Nat) (dy dx : Int)
    (fill minColors target y x : Nat)
    (hcolors : ∀ c, c ∈ colors → c ≠ target)
    (hfill : fill ≠ target)
    (hy : y < g.length) (hx : x < (g.getD y []).length)
    (hout : cellAt (translateBlock g colors dy dx destOk fill minColors) y x = target) :
    cellAt g y x = target := by
  unfold translateBlock at hout
  rw [cellAt_gridMap (g := g) (y := y) (x := x) hy hx] at hout
  set comps := (componentsOf g colors).filter
    (fun comp => compOk g comp dy dx destOk minColors) with hcomps
  set movedSrc := comps.flatten with hmoved
  set src : Int × Int := ((y : Int) - dy, (x : Int) - dx) with hsrcdef
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.contains_iff_mem] at hout
  by_cases hcopy :
      (0 ≤ src.1 ∧ 0 ≤ src.2) ∧ (src.1.toNat, src.2.toNat) ∈ movedSrc
  · simp [hcopy] at hout
    have hmem : (src.1.toNat, src.2.toNat) ∈ movedSrc := by
      exact hcopy.2
    have hmatch :
        (src.1.toNat, src.2.toNat) ∈ matchCells g colors := by
      simpa [hmoved, hcomps] using
        (movedSrc_mem_matchCells (g := g) (colors := colors) (destOk := destOk)
        (dy := dy) (dx := dx) (minColors := minColors) hmem)
    have hcol := matchCells_mem_color hmatch
    exact False.elim ((hcolors _ hcol) hout)
  · simp [hcopy] at hout
    by_cases hcur : (y, x) ∈ movedSrc
    · simp [hcur] at hout
      exact False.elim (hfill hout)
    · simpa [hcur] using hout

lemma row_target_count_le (target : Nat) :
    ∀ (out row : List Nat), out.length = row.length →
      (∀ x, x < row.length → out.getD x 0 = target → row.getD x 0 = target) →
      (out.filter (fun v => v == target)).length ≤
        (row.filter (fun v => v == target)).length
  | [], [], _hlen, _himp => by simp
  | [], _b :: _bs, hlen, _himp => by simp at hlen
  | _a :: _as, [], hlen, _himp => by simp at hlen
  | a :: as, b :: bs, hlen, himp => by
      simp at hlen
      have htail :
          (as.filter (fun v => v == target)).length ≤
            (bs.filter (fun v => v == target)).length := by
        refine row_target_count_le target as bs hlen ?_
        intro x hx hout
        have h := himp (x + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hx) ?_
        · simpa [List.getD] using h
        · simpa [List.getD] using hout
      have hhead : a = target → b = target := by
        intro ha
        have h := himp 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) ?_
        · simpa [List.getD] using h
        · simpa [List.getD] using ha
      by_cases ha : a = target
      · have hb : b = target := hhead ha
        simp [ha, hb, htail]
      · by_cases hb : b = target
        · simp [ha, hb]
          omega
        · simp [ha, hb, htail]

lemma foldl_add_eq_add_foldl (xs : List Nat) (a : Nat) :
    xs.foldl (fun x y => x + y) a = a + xs.foldl (fun x y => x + y) 0 := by
  induction xs generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [List.foldl_cons, ih (a + x), List.foldl_cons, ih (0 + x)]
      omega

lemma countColor_cons (row : List Nat) (rows : Grid) (target : Nat) :
    countColor (row :: rows) target =
      (row.filter (fun v => v == target)).length + countColor rows target := by
  unfold countColor
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
  rw [foldl_add_eq_add_foldl]
  omega

lemma countColor_le_of_cellAt_imp (target : Nat) :
    ∀ (out g : Grid), out.length = g.length →
      (∀ y, y < g.length → (out.getD y []).length = (g.getD y []).length) →
      (∀ y x, y < g.length → x < (g.getD y []).length →
        cellAt out y x = target → cellAt g y x = target) →
      countColor out target ≤ countColor g target
  | [], [], _hlen, _hrow, _hcell => by simp [countColor]
  | [], _r :: _rs, hlen, _hrow, _hcell => by simp at hlen
  | _r :: _rs, [], hlen, _hrow, _hcell => by simp at hlen
  | outRow :: outRows, row :: rows, hlen, hrow, hcell => by
      simp at hlen
      have hhead :
          (outRow.filter (fun v => v == target)).length ≤
            (row.filter (fun v => v == target)).length := by
        refine row_target_count_le target outRow row (hrow 0 (Nat.succ_pos _)) ?_
        intro x hx hout
        have h := hcell 0 x (Nat.succ_pos _) hx ?_
        · simpa [cellAt, List.getD] using h
        · simpa [cellAt, List.getD] using hout
      have htail :
          countColor outRows target ≤ countColor rows target := by
        refine countColor_le_of_cellAt_imp target outRows rows hlen ?_ ?_
        · intro y hy
          have h := hrow (y + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hy)
          simpa [List.getD] using h
        · intro y x hy hx hout
          have h := hcell (y + 1) x (Nat.succ_lt_succ hy) hx ?_
          · simpa [cellAt, List.getD] using h
          · simpa [cellAt, List.getD] using hout
      rw [countColor_cons, countColor_cons]
      omega

lemma translateBlock_length (g : Grid) (colors destOk : List Nat) (dy dx : Int)
    (fill minColors : Nat) :
    (translateBlock g colors dy dx destOk fill minColors).length = g.length := by
  simp [translateBlock, gridMap]

lemma translateBlock_row_length (g : Grid) (colors destOk : List Nat) (dy dx : Int)
    (fill minColors y : Nat) (hy : y < g.length) :
    ((translateBlock g colors dy dx destOk fill minColors).getD y []).length =
      (g.getD y []).length := by
  unfold translateBlock
  exact gridMap_row_length g
    (fun y x c =>
      let src := ((y : Int) - dy, (x : Int) - dx)
      if decide (0 ≤ src.1) && decide (0 ≤ src.2) &&
         ((componentsOf g colors).filter
            (fun comp => compOk g comp dy dx destOk minColors)).flatten.contains
            (src.1.toNat, src.2.toNat) then
        cellAt g src.1.toNat src.2.toNat
      else if ((componentsOf g colors).filter
            (fun comp => compOk g comp dy dx destOk minColors)).flatten.contains (y, x) then
        fill
      else c)
    y hy

-- RECEIPT: GENERALIZE — `translateBlock` only copies source colors from `colors`, writes `fill`, or preserves an old cell; excluding the target from `colors` and `fill` gives monotonicity for any target color.
theorem translateBlock_countColor_le (g : Grid) (colors destOk : List Nat) (dy dx : Int)
    (fill minColors target : Nat)
    (hcolors : ∀ c, c ∈ colors → c ≠ target)
    (hfill : fill ≠ target) :
    countColor (translateBlock g colors dy dx destOk fill minColors) target ≤
      countColor g target := by
  refine countColor_le_of_cellAt_imp target
    (translateBlock g colors dy dx destOk fill minColors) g ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact translateBlock_length g colors destOk dy dx fill minColors
  · intro y hy
    exact translateBlock_row_length g colors destOk dy dx fill minColors y hy
  · intro y x hy hx hout
    exact translateBlock_cell_target_imp g colors destOk dy dx fill minColors target y x
      hcolors hfill hy hx hout

structure ConstantProductPool where

  reserveY : NNReal

                                                                       

def PoolWellFormed (p : ConstantProductPool) : Prop :=
  0 < p.reserveX ∧ 0 < p.reserveY

  p.reserveX * p.reserveY

                                                                       

structure FeeFactor where
  gamma : NNReal
  gamma_pos : 0 < gamma
  gamma_le_one : gamma ≤ 1

  reserveY := p.reserveY + dy

/-!
# Gale-Shapley deferred acceptance substrate

This file records the formal substrate for a man-proposing deferred acceptance
campaign.  The first pass deliberately keeps the mechanism data ordinary:
preferences are strict decidable relations, a matching is an assignment from
women to optional men, and proposal states carry the current held assignment
plus each man's remaining proposal list.
-/

namespace GaleShapleyStableMatching

universe u v

/-- A strict, decidable, tie-free preference relation for each agent over an
opposite-side alternative type. -/
structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

section Preferences

variable {Agent : Type u} {Alt : Type v}

theorem anchor_StrictPreference_asymm
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) (agent : Agent) {x y : Alt}
    (hxy : prefs.pref agent x y) :
    ¬ prefs.pref agent y x := by
  intro hyx
  exact prefs.irrefl agent x (prefs.trans agent hxy hyx)

theorem anchor_StrictPreference_exactly_one_of_ne
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) (agent : Agent) {x y : Alt}
    (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (prefs.pref agent x y ∧ ¬ prefs.pref agent y x) ∨
      (prefs.pref agent y x ∧ ¬ prefs.pref agent x y) := by
  rcases prefs.total agent hxy with hp | hp
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hp, anchor_StrictPreference_asymm prefs agent hp⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hp, anchor_StrictPreference_asymm prefs agent hp⟩

/-- Weak preference induced by a strict preference: equality or strict
preference. -/
def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

theorem anchor_WeaklyPrefers_characterization
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefs agent x y ↔ x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y :=
  Iff.rfl

end Preferences

section Choice

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- The man a woman prefers from a two-man menu.  It is intentionally a direct
`if` on her strict preference so the two branches reduce. -/
def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

theorem sanity_chooseBetterForW_left
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) {w : Woman} {a b : Man}
    (h : prefW.pref w a b) :
    chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = a := by
  simp [chooseBetterForW, h]

theorem sanity_chooseBetterForW_right
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) {w : Woman} {a b : Man}
    (h : ¬ prefW.pref w a b) :
    chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = b := by
  simp [chooseBetterForW, h]

theorem anchor_chooseBetterForW_returns_arg
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (a b : Man) :
    chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = a ∨ chooseBetterForW prefW w a b = b := by
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w a b
  · exact Or.inl (sanity_chooseBetterForW_left prefW h)
  · exact Or.inr (sanity_chooseBetterForW_right prefW h)

theorem anchor_chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_left
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (a b : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w a b) a := by
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w a b
  · simp [WeaklyPrefers, chooseBetterForW, h]
  · have hba_or : b = a ∨ prefW.pref w b a := by
      by_cases hEq : b = a
      · exact Or.inl hEq
      · rcases prefW.total w hEq with hba | hab
        · exact Or.inr hba
        · exact False.elim (h hab)
    rcases hba_or with hEq | hba
    · simp [WeaklyPrefers, chooseBetterForW, h, hEq]
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa [chooseBetterForW, h] using hba)

theorem anchor_chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_right
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (a b : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w a b) b := by
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w a b
  · exact Or.inr (by simpa [chooseBetterForW, h] using h)
  · simp [WeaklyPrefers, chooseBetterForW, h]

end Choice

section Matching

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- A tentative matching is represented by the man each woman currently holds,
if any. -/
structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/
def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

theorem anchor_NoDuplicateHolds_characterization (μ : Matching Man Woman) :
    NoDuplicateHolds μ ↔
      ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man},
        μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂ :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- The empty matching. -/
def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

theorem sanity_emptyMatching_noDuplicate :
    NoDuplicateHolds (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman) := by
  intro w₁ w₂ m h
  cases h

@[simp] theorem sanity_emptyMatching_held (w : Woman) :
    (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman).held w = none :=
  rfl

/-- A man is free when no woman currently holds him. -/
def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

theorem anchor_freeMan_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) :
    freeMan μ m ↔ ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem sanity_emptyMatching_free [DecidableEq Man] (m : Man) :
    freeMan (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman) m := by
  intro w
  simp [freeMan, emptyMatching]

/-- The woman holding a given man, if one exists.  Under `NoDuplicateHolds` this
is independent of the witness chosen. -/
noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

@[simp] theorem sanity_partnerOfMan_empty (m : Man) :
    partnerOfMan (emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman) m = none := by
  unfold partnerOfMan emptyMatching
  simp

theorem anchor_partnerOfMan_some_iff_of_noDuplicate : ∀ [DecidableEq Man] {μ : Matching Man Woman}
    (hμ : NoDuplicateHolds μ) (m : Man) (w : Woman), partnerOfMan μ m = some w ↔ μ.held w = some m := by
  intro _ μ hμ m w
  constructor
  · intro hp
    unfold partnerOfMan at hp
    classical
    by_cases h : ∃ w' : Woman, μ.held w' = some m
    · simp [h] at hp
      rw [← hp]
      exact Classical.choose_spec h
    · simp [h] at hp
  · intro hw
    unfold partnerOfMan
    classical
    have h : ∃ w' : Woman, μ.held w' = some m := ⟨w, hw⟩
    have hchoose : μ.held (Classical.choose h) = some m := Classical.choose_spec h
    have hcw : Classical.choose h = w := hμ hchoose hw
    simp [h, hcw]

-- [family-lemma-library] banked: FreeManIn
def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=

-- [family-lemma-library] banked: ProposalStepRel
structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

/-- The opening state: nobody is held, and every man has his full proposal list. -/

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,

    ProposalState Man Woman → List Man → ProposalState Man Woman → Prop
  | nil (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : ProposalRun prefW state [] state
  | cons {state mid final : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man} {schedule : List Man} :
      ProposalStepRel prefW state m mid →
        ProposalRun prefW mid schedule final →

-- - **Man / Woman**: the two finite sides of the market (the proposing side and the receiving side).
-- - **prefM / prefW**: `prefM m x y` means man `m` strictly prefers woman `x` to woman `y`; `prefW w a b` means woman
--   `w` strictly prefers man `a` to man `b`. Each is a **strict linear order over the opposite side** — irreflexive,
--   transitive, and total on distinct agents (any two distinct alternatives are comparable) — and **decidable**, so
--   the choice tests below `REDUCE` rather than sitting behind an opaque `∃`.
-- - **chooseBetterForW**: given a woman `w` and two men, the man `w` prefers — a **plain computable `def`** by a
--   direct `if` on the decidable `prefW` (so `simp [chooseBetterForW]` / `if_pos` reduce it). It returns one of the
--   two men, never a third.
-- - **Matching**: an assignment `held : Woman → Option Man` (the man a woman currently holds, or none) in which no man
--   is held by two women — the deferred-acceptance process maintains this injectivity, since a man proposes only while
--   unheld. **partnerOfMan**: the woman holding a given man, or none (well-defined by that injectivity).
-- - **freeMan**: a man no woman currently holds.
-- - **BlockingPair**: a man `m` and woman `w` such that `m` strictly prefers `w` to `partnerOfMan m` (or `m` is a
--   freeMan) **and** `w` strictly prefers `m` to `held w` (or `w` holds no one) — both would defect from the match to
--   pair with each other. Formalize it as a **decidable** predicate on the two `Option` partners (a `Bool`/`Decidable
--   Prop` that reduces), never an opaque existential.
-- - **Stable**: a matching with **no** blocking pair.
-- - **ProposalState**: the deferred-acceptance state — the current `held : Woman → Option Man` together with, for each
--   man, `rem : Man → List Woman`, the women he has **not yet** proposed to, in his strict preference order.
-- - **openingState**: every woman holds no one (`held w = none`) and every man's `rem` is his full preference-ordered
--   list of women.
-- - **proposalStep**: a **plain computable `def`** advancing one proposal — given a freeMan `m` whose `rem m` is
--   nonempty, `m` proposes to its head `w`; `w` becomes `chooseBetterForW w` applied to her current holder and `m`
--   (keeping the better, rejecting the other); `rem m` drops its head. A step that names an ineligible man is the
--   identity. Define it by a **direct `if`** on the decidable freeMan/`rem` tests so it unfolds definitionally.
-- - **postProposals**: apply a finite proposal **schedule** (a `List Man`, the order in which men are activated to
--   make their next proposal) to a state in order — a left fold of `proposalStep`.
-- - **reachable**: a state equal to `postProposals sched openingState` for some finite schedule `sched`.
-- - **Quiescent**: a state in which **no** freeMan has a nonempty `rem` — every man is either held by a woman or has
--   exhausted his preference list. The completeness hypothesis of the Target.
--
-- ## Anchors (prove these — they PIN each def's meaning; a representation-dependent def cannot prove them)
-- - **chooseBetterForW returns the woman's genuine preference-maximum of the two**: for any woman `w` and men `a`, `b`,
--   `chooseBetterForW w a b` is one of `a`, `b`, and `w` weakly prefers it to both. A positional / first-argument
--   choice cannot prove this — the anchor forces the preference-driven selection, the analog of `bestBid` being the
--   max rather than a list head.
-- - **prefW / prefM are strict linear orders — comparability and no ties**: for distinct men `a`, `b`, exactly one of
--   `prefW w a b` and `prefW w b a` holds (symmetrically for `prefM`). This forces the total, tie-free preference
--   relation the "most preferred remaining" pointer and the blocking test rely on, over a merely partial or
--   positional ranking.
--
-- ## Target
-- Consider man-proposing deferred acceptance over two finite sides with strict preferences: starting from the empty
-- matching, unengaged men propose to women in strict order of preference, and each woman tentatively holds the best
-- proposer she has seen and rejects the rest, a held man being displaced only by one she strictly prefers. After
-- **any** finite proposal schedule that runs to quiescence — no unengaged man has an un-proposed woman left — the
-- resulting matching is **stable**: there is no blocking pair, i.e. no man and woman who each strictly prefer the
-- other to the partner the match assigned them. So the outcome of a complete deferred-acceptance run is immune to
-- pairwise defection. Surface that quiescence is load-bearing: an incomplete run can leave an unengaged man who
-- strictly prefers a woman he never reached, and that pair blocks — so stability is a property of the **completed**
-- run, not of an arbitrary partial one. (The dual guarantee that a quiescent state is always reached — termination
-- and hence existence of a stable matching — is the liveness result this target does not cover.)
--

-- - Along any proposal schedule from the opening state, a woman's held man is monotone under her preference: at any
--   reachable state she weakly prefers her held man to any man she held at an earlier reachable state, and once she
--   holds a man she is never again free.
-- - If a woman rejects a man at some reachable state — she keeps or takes another over him — then at every later
--   reachable state she holds a man she strictly prefers to the one she rejected.
-- - The women a man has already proposed to form an initial segment of his preference order at every reachable state;
--   in particular, at a quiescent state a man has proposed to every woman he strictly prefers to his own assigned
--   partner (and to every woman, if he is unengaged).
-- - At a quiescent reachable state the matching is stable: for every man `m` and woman `w`, they are not a blocking
--   pair — the completed run leaves no pair who would both defect to each other.
-- - Quiescence is load-bearing: there is a profile and a non-quiescent reachable state whose matching has a blocking
--   pair, so the quiescence hypothesis in the stability claim cannot be dropped.
--
-- ## Idea

-- induct on the schedule, and at each `proposalStep` the woman it touches either keeps her holder or replaces it by

-- carried along the fold. The rejected-dominated lemma is the same invariant read at a rejection: `chooseBetterForW`
-- kept a man she prefers to the rejected one, and monotonicity carries it forward. The initial-segment lemma is
-- structural: `rem m` starts as `m`'s full preference-ordered list and `proposalStep` drops only its head, so the
-- proposed set is exactly the complement prefix. Stability at quiescence combines them: if `m` strictly prefers `w` to
-- his partner then by the initial-segment lemma `m` proposed to `w`, and — since he is not held by her — she rejected
-- him, so by the rejected-dominated lemma she holds a man she strictly prefers to `m`; hence `w` does not prefer `m`
-- to her partner and `(m, w)` is no blocking pair. The load-bearing witness is a small explicit market (a couple of
-- men and women) run one step short of quiescence, exhibiting a surviving blocking pair. Probe Mathlib's `List.foldl`
-- and `List` prefix lemmas and the order/decidability machinery; keep the two sides as finite parameters and the

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

@[simp] theorem sanity_updateHeld_same [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    updateHeld held w newHeld w = newHeld := by
  simp [updateHeld]

theorem sanity_updateHeld_ne [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) {w w' : Woman} (newHeld : Option Man)
    (hne : w' ≠ w) :
    updateHeld held w newHeld w' = held w' := by
  simp [updateHeld, hne]

section Stability

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- Man-side strict preference over a concrete optional current partner.  Being
unmatched makes every woman strictly better than the current outcome. -/
def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

instance instDecidableManPrefersOption
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) (partner : Option Woman) :
    Decidable (ManPrefersOption prefM m w partner) := by
  cases partner with
  | none => exact isTrue trivial
  | some w' => exact prefM.decidablePref m w w'

theorem anchor_ManPrefersOption_none
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    ManPrefersOption prefM m w none ↔ True :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem anchor_ManPrefersOption_some
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w w' : Woman) :
    ManPrefersOption prefM m w (some w') ↔ prefM.pref m w w' :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Woman-side strict preference over a concrete optional current holder.  An
unmatched woman strictly prefers any proposer to being unmatched. -/
def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

instance instDecidableWomanPrefersOption
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (m : Man) (partner : Option Man) :
    Decidable (WomanPrefersOption prefW w m partner) := by
  cases partner with
  | none => exact isTrue trivial
  | some m' => exact prefW.decidablePref w m m'

theorem anchor_WomanPrefersOption_none
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (m : Man) :
    WomanPrefersOption prefW w m none ↔ True :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem anchor_WomanPrefersOption_some
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (m m' : Man) :
    WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (some m') ↔ prefW.pref w m m' :=
  Iff.rfl

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

theorem anchor_ManPrefersCurrent_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ↔
      ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- A blocking pair: both sides strictly prefer pairing with each other to their
current options. -/
noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

theorem anchor_BlockingPair_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w ↔
      ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- A stable matching has no blocking pair. -/
noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

theorem anchor_Stable_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) :
    Stable prefM prefW μ ↔ ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w :=
  Iff.rfl

end Stability

section States

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

/-- Deferred-acceptance state: current tentative matching plus each man's
remaining proposal list. -/

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

@[simp] theorem sanity_openingState_held (fullList : Man → List Woman) (w : Woman) :
    (openingState fullList).matching.held w = none :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem sanity_openingState_rem (fullList : Man → List Woman) (m : Man) :
    (openingState fullList).rem m = fullList m :=
  rfl

theorem sanity_openingState_free [DecidableEq Man]
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (m : Man) :
    freeMan (openingState fullList).matching m := by
  exact sanity_emptyMatching_free m

/-- A proposal list is written in decreasing strict preference order. -/
def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

theorem anchor_ProposalListOrdered_pairwise
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (women : List Woman) :
    ProposalListOrdered prefM m women ↔
      women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂) :=
  Iff.rfl

@[simp] theorem sanity_ProposalListOrdered_nil
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) :
    ProposalListOrdered prefM m [] := by
  simp [ProposalListOrdered]

@[simp] theorem sanity_ProposalListOrdered_singleton
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    ProposalListOrdered prefM m [w] := by
  simp [ProposalListOrdered]

/-- Initial proposal lists contain no duplicate women and are ordered by the
man's strict preference. -/
def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

theorem anchor_ProposalListsSound_characterization
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (fullList : Man → List Woman) :
    ProposalListsSound prefM fullList ↔
      ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- One activation in the proposal schedule.  A non-free man, or a free man with
no remaining women, leaves the state unchanged. -/
def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)
        { matching := { held := updateHeld state.matching.held w nextHeld }
          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

theorem sanity_proposalStep_not_free_identity
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    {state : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man}
    (hnot : ¬ freeMan state.matching m) :
    proposalStep prefW state m = state := by
  simp [proposalStep, hnot]

theorem sanity_proposalStep_empty_rem_identity
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    {state : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man}
    (hfree : freeMan state.matching m) (hrem : state.rem m = []) :
    proposalStep prefW state m = state := by
  simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem]

theorem sanity_proposalStep_empty_woman_holds_proposer
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    {state : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man} {w : Woman} {tail : List Woman}
    (hfree : freeMan state.matching m) (hrem : state.rem m = w :: tail)
    (hheld : state.matching.held w = none) :
    (proposalStep prefW state m).matching.held w = some m := by
  simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld]

theorem sanity_proposalStep_drops_head
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    {state : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man} {w : Woman} {tail : List Woman}
    (hfree : freeMan state.matching m) (hrem : state.rem m = w :: tail) :
    (proposalStep prefW state m).rem m = tail := by
  simp [proposalStep, hfree, hrem]

/-- Apply a finite proposal schedule in order. -/
def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

@[simp] theorem sanity_postProposals_nil
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (state : ProposalState Man Woman) :
    postProposals prefW state [] = state :=
  rfl

theorem sanity_postProposals_cons
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (schedule : List Man) :
    postProposals prefW state (m :: schedule) =
      postProposals prefW (proposalStep prefW state m) schedule :=
  rfl

/-- Reachability from the opening state under some finite proposal schedule. -/
def Reachable [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∃ schedule : List Man, postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state

theorem anchor_Reachable_exists_schedule
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (state : ProposalState Man Woman) :
    Reachable prefW fullList state ↔
      ∃ schedule : List Man, postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Quiescence: no free man has any unproposed woman left. -/
def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

theorem anchor_Quiescent_characterization [DecidableEq Man]
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) :
    Quiescent state ↔ ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = [] :=
  Iff.rfl

end States

section UnitWitnesses

/-- The unique strict preference on a singleton side. -/
def unitStrictPreference : StrictPreference Unit Unit :=
  { pref := fun _ _ _ => False
    decidablePref := fun _ _ _ => isFalse id
    irrefl := by intro _ _ h; exact h
    trans := by intro _ _ _ _ h _; exact False.elim h
    total := by
      intro _ x y hxy
      cases x
      cases y
      exact False.elim (hxy rfl) }

/-- A one-couple matching. -/
def unitMatching : Matching Unit Unit :=
  { held := fun _ => some () }

theorem sanity_unitMatching_noDuplicate :
    NoDuplicateHolds unitMatching := by
  intro w₁ w₂ m _ _
  cases w₁
  cases w₂
  rfl

theorem witness_NoDuplicateHolds_nonvacuous_unit :
    NoDuplicateHolds unitMatching ∧ ∃ w m, unitMatching.held w = some m := by
  constructor
  · exact sanity_unitMatching_noDuplicate
  · exact ⟨(), (), rfl⟩

@[simp] theorem sanity_partnerOfMan_unit :
    partnerOfMan unitMatching () = some () := by
  unfold partnerOfMan unitMatching
  simp

theorem witness_Stable_nonvacuous_unit :
    Stable unitStrictPreference unitStrictPreference unitMatching := by
  intro m w hblock
  cases m
  cases w
  simp [BlockingPair, ManPrefersCurrent, ManPrefersOption, WomanPrefersOption,
    unitStrictPreference] at hblock

def unitQuiescentState : ProposalState Unit Unit :=
  { matching := unitMatching, rem := fun _ => [] }

theorem witness_Quiescent_nonvacuous_unit :
    Quiescent unitQuiescentState ∧ ∃ m, ¬ freeMan unitQuiescentState.matching m := by
  constructor
  · intro m _
    cases m
    rfl
  · refine ⟨(), ?_⟩
    intro hfree
    exact hfree () rfl

import Mathlib

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure ExposureComponents (K : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrder K]
    [IsStrictOrderedRing K] where
  onBalance : K
  offBalance : K
  creditConversion : K
  onBalance_nonneg : 0 ≤ onBalance
  offBalance_nonneg : 0 ≤ offBalance
  creditConversion_nonneg : 0 ≤ creditConversion
  creditConversion_le_one : creditConversion ≤ 1

/--
Anchor (characterization): equality of exposure-component bundles is equality
of the three economic fields.  The remaining fields are proof data.
-/

def TotalExposureMeasure (x : ExposureComponents K) : K :=
  x.onBalance + x.creditConversion * x.offBalance

/-- Anchor (characterization): total exposure is exactly the Basel sum. -/

def RiskWeightInRange (w : K) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ w ∧ w ≤ 1

/-- Anchor (characterization): risk-weight range is exactly membership in `Set.Icc 0 1`. -/

def LowRiskWeightCrossover (w : K) : Prop :=
  8 * w ≤ 3

/-- Anchor (characterization): the crossover is the equivalent `w ≤ 3/8` boundary. -/

def RiskWeightedExposure (exposure w : K) : K :=
  w * exposure

/-- Anchor (characterization): risk-weighted exposure is Mathlib multiplication. -/

def LeverageCompliant (tier1 exposure : K) : Prop :=
  100 * tier1 ≥ 3 * exposure

/-- Anchor (characterization): leverage compliance is the cross-multiplied 3% floor. -/

def RiskWeightedCapitalFloor (tier1 exposure w : K) : Prop :=
  100 * tier1 ≥ 8 * RiskWeightedExposure exposure w

/-- Anchor (characterization): risk-weighted floor is the cross-multiplied 8% floor. -/

-- APPROACH (advisory blueprint / proof-idea guidance; the kernel verifies every step):
-- # Basel III Leverage Ratio — a non-risk-based capital backstop
--
-- Opens a new domain for the library: **prudential banking regulation (Basel III)**. The leverage ratio is Basel
-- III's deliberately crude companion to the risk-weighted capital ratios: Tier-1 capital divided by a **total
-- exposure measure** must not fall below a flat **3%** floor, with *no risk weighting at all*. Its whole reason for
-- existing is contested institutional intent, not mathematics — after 2008 the Committee added it precisely because
-- risk weights are model-dependent and gameable, so a bank could show a comfortable risk-weighted ratio while being
-- catastrophically levered on assets its own models rated near-zero-risk. The leverage ratio is the **backstop that
-- binds when the risk weights are gamed**. That intent — "a floor that holds regardless of how the assets are
-- weighted" — is exactly the kind of non-mathematical, numeric-boundary rule this library exists to formalize
-- faithfully and certify, and no filed result yet exercises the numeric-boundary firewall.
--
-- Assumption-accounting note: the results depend on (1) **nonnegativity** — Tier-1 capital and every exposure
-- component are nonnegative monetary quantities; (2) the **total exposure measure** being the genuine on-balance-
-- sheet *plus* off-balance-sheet-via-credit-conversion measure (a measure at least as large as on-balance assets
-- alone — the conservatism is the point, so it must not be modelled as on-balance-only); (3) the **3% floor** and
-- the **8% risk-weighted capital minimum** as the actual Basel Pillar-1 constants, not free parameters. Surface where
-- each is used. Keep the model over an ordered field of real-valued quantities; do **not** collapse it to a fixed
-- decidable integer instance (that would trivialize the boundary the firewall is meant to police). A non-closure is
-- an honest gap, never a fake closure.
--
-- ## Domain
-- formalization-nonmath
--
-- ## Theory file
-- basel_leverage_theory.lean
--
-- ## Vocabulary (build these as definitions — do not prove them)
-- - **Total exposure measure**: an institution's total exposure is its on-balance-sheet assets plus its
--   off-balance-sheet notional scaled by a credit-conversion factor in `[0,1]`; hence total exposure is nonnegative
--   and at least as large as on-balance-sheet assets alone.
-- - **Leverage-compliant**: an institution is leverage-compliant when its Tier-1 capital is at least 3% of its total

import Mathlib

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure ExposureComponents (K : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrder K]
    [IsStrictOrderedRing K] where
  onBalance : K
  offBalance : K
  creditConversion : K
  onBalance_nonneg : 0 ≤ onBalance
  offBalance_nonneg : 0 ≤ offBalance
  creditConversion_nonneg : 0 ≤ creditConversion
  creditConversion_le_one : creditConversion ≤ 1

/--
Anchor (characterization): equality of exposure-component bundles is equality
of the three economic fields.  The remaining fields are proof data.
-/

def TotalExposureMeasure (x : ExposureComponents K) : K :=
  x.onBalance + x.creditConversion * x.offBalance

/-- Anchor (characterization): total exposure is exactly the Basel sum. -/

def RiskWeightInRange (w : K) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ w ∧ w ≤ 1

/-- Anchor (characterization): risk-weight range is exactly membership in `Set.Icc 0 1`. -/

def LowRiskWeightCrossover (w : K) : Prop :=
  8 * w ≤ 3

/-- Anchor (characterization): the crossover is the equivalent `w ≤ 3/8` boundary. -/

def RiskWeightedExposure (exposure w : K) : K :=
  w * exposure

/-- Anchor (characterization): risk-weighted exposure is Mathlib multiplication. -/

def LeverageCompliant (tier1 exposure : K) : Prop :=
  100 * tier1 ≥ 3 * exposure

/-- Anchor (characterization): leverage compliance is the cross-multiplied 3% floor. -/

namespace ByzantineQuorumIntersection

open Finset

abbrev Nodes (n : ℕ) := Fin n

/-- A quorum/fault set over `n` nodes. -/
abbrev NodeSet (n : ℕ) := Finset (Nodes n)

/-- An at-most-`f` faulty set. -/
def FaultAdmissible (n f : ℕ) (F : NodeSet n) : Prop :=
  F.card ≤ f

/-- A node is correct with respect to a concrete faulty set. -/
def CorrectNode {n : ℕ} (F : NodeSet n) (x : Nodes n) : Prop :=
  x ∉ F

/-- A concrete quorum for threshold `q`. -/
def ThresholdQuorum (n q : ℕ) (Q : NodeSet n) : Prop :=
  q ≤ Q.card

/-- The size-`q` threshold quorum family. -/
def ThresholdQuorumSystem (n q : ℕ) : Set (NodeSet n) :=
  {Q | ThresholdQuorum n q Q}

/--
Set-level threshold safety: every two threshold quorums share a node outside
every admissible faulty set.
-/
def ThresholdSafe (n f q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ Q₁ Q₂ : NodeSet n,
    ThresholdQuorum n q Q₁ →
    ThresholdQuorum n q Q₂ →
    ∀ F : NodeSet n,
      FaultAdmissible n f F →
      ((Q₁ ∩ Q₂) \ F).Nonempty

/--
Set-level availability: after removing any admissible faulty set, some
threshold quorum remains disjoint from it.
-/
def ThresholdAvailable (n f q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ F : NodeSet n,
    FaultAdmissible n f F →
    ∃ Q : NodeSet n, ThresholdQuorum n q Q ∧ Disjoint Q F

/-- Numeric side condition sufficient for threshold safety. -/
def ThresholdSafeBound (n f q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  n + f + 1 ≤ 2 * q

/-- Numeric side condition expressing that a correct quorum fits. -/
def ThresholdAvailableBound (n f q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  q + f ≤ n

/-- Numeric simultaneous safe-and-available region. -/
def ThresholdSafeAndAvailableBound (n f q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ThresholdSafeBound n f q ∧ ThresholdAvailableBound n f q

def tightLowerQuorum (f : ℕ) : NodeSet (3 * f + 1) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (3 * f + 1) => (x : ℕ) < 2 * f + 1)

/-- Upper concrete quorum at the tight point: nodes `≥ f`. -/
def tightUpperQuorum (f : ℕ) : NodeSet (3 * f + 1) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (3 * f + 1) => f ≤ (x : ℕ))

def boundaryLowFaults (f : ℕ) : NodeSet (3 * f) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (3 * f) => (x : ℕ) < f)

/-- The middle `f` nodes inside `Fin (3f)`. -/
def boundaryMidFaults (f : ℕ) : NodeSet (3 * f) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (3 * f) => f ≤ (x : ℕ) ∧ (x : ℕ) < 2 * f)

/-- The last `f` nodes inside `Fin (3f)`. -/
def boundaryHighFaults (f : ℕ) : NodeSet (3 * f) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin (3 * f) => 2 * f ≤ (x : ℕ))

theorem card_sdiff_pos_of_card_lt
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {A B : Finset α}
    (h : B.card < A.card) :
    0 < (A \ B).card := by
  have hInterLe : (A ∩ B).card ≤ B.card := by
    exact Finset.card_le_card (by intro x hx; exact (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2)
  have hInterLt : (A ∩ B).card < A.card := lt_of_le_of_lt hInterLe h
  have hsplit := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter A B
  omega

theorem sdiff_nonempty_of_card_lt
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {A B : Finset α}
    (h : B.card < A.card) :
    (A \ B).Nonempty := by
  exact Finset.card_pos.mp (card_sdiff_pos_of_card_lt h)

theorem card_inter_gt_faults_of_threshold
    {n f q : ℕ}
    (hsafe : ThresholdSafeBound n f q)
    {Q₁ Q₂ : NodeSet n}
    (hQ₁ : ThresholdQuorum n q Q₁)
    (hQ₂ : ThresholdQuorum n q Q₂)
    {F : NodeSet n}
    (hF : FaultAdmissible n f F) :
    F.card < (Q₁ ∩ Q₂).card := by
  change n + f + 1 ≤ 2 * q at hsafe
  change q ≤ Q₁.card at hQ₁
  change q ≤ Q₂.card at hQ₂
  change F.card ≤ f at hF
  have hUnionLe : (Q₁ ∪ Q₂).card ≤ n := by
    simpa using (Finset.card_le_univ (Q₁ ∪ Q₂))
  have hInterUnion := Finset.card_inter_add_card_union Q₁ Q₂
  have hCardLe : Q₁.card + Q₂.card ≤ (Q₁ ∩ Q₂).card + n := by
    calc
      Q₁.card + Q₂.card = (Q₁ ∩ Q₂).card + (Q₁ ∪ Q₂).card := by
        exact hInterUnion.symm
      _ ≤ (Q₁ ∩ Q₂).card + n := by
        exact Nat.add_le_add_left hUnionLe _
  have hTwoQ : 2 * q ≤ Q₁.card + Q₂.card := by
    omega
  have hFaultPlus : F.card + 1 ≤ (Q₁ ∩ Q₂).card := by
    omega
  omega

theorem thresholdSafe_of_safeBound
    {n f q : ℕ}
    (hsafe : ThresholdSafeBound n f q) :
    ThresholdSafe n f q := by
  intro Q₁ Q₂ hQ₁ hQ₂ F hF
  exact sdiff_nonempty_of_card_lt
    (card_inter_gt_faults_of_threshold hsafe hQ₁ hQ₂ hF)

theorem thresholdAvailable_of_availableBound
    {n f q : ℕ}
    (hfit : ThresholdAvailableBound n f q) :
    ThresholdAvailable n f q := by
  intro F hF
  refine ⟨Finset.univ \ F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcard : (Finset.univ \ F).card = n - F.card := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff]
      simp
    rw [ThresholdQuorum, hcard]
    apply Nat.le_sub_of_add_le
    change q + f ≤ n at hfit
    change F.card ≤ f at hF
    omega
  · simpa [disjoint_comm] using
      (Finset.disjoint_sdiff (s := F) (t := (Finset.univ : NodeSet n)))

theorem exists_thresholdSafeBound_and_availableBound_iff
    (n f : ℕ) :
    (∃ q : ℕ, ThresholdSafeAndAvailableBound n f q) ↔
      3 * f + 1 ≤ n := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hsafe, havail⟩
    dsimp [ThresholdSafeAndAvailableBound,
      ThresholdSafeBound, ThresholdAvailableBound] at hsafe havail
    omega
  · intro h
    refine ⟨n - f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [ThresholdSafeAndAvailableBound, ThresholdSafeBound]
      omega
    · dsimp [ThresholdAvailableBound]
      omega

theorem no_safe_available_bound_at_three_f
    {f : ℕ} (hf : 1 ≤ f) :
    ¬ ∃ q : ℕ, ThresholdSafeAndAvailableBound (3 * f) f q := by

  · exact tightUpperQuorum_ne_univ hf

    rcases hnonempty with ⟨x, hx⟩
